mechanism: Fluoxetine potentiates varenicline's CNS effects (nausea, dizziness, neuropsychiatric symptoms) through additive serotonergic activity and increased varenicline exposure via CYP2D6 inhibition.
action: Monitor closely for increased adverse effects including nausea, dizziness, and neuropsychiatric symptoms; dose reduction of varenicline may be necessary in some patients.
